thread:
sam: Hey team — customer AcmeCorp hit a burst from a promo and started getting 429s. Looks like burst credits dropped to 0 and haven't refilled after ~15m. Example request ids: req_0a1b, req_0a1c. They're on hosted paid tier. Any quick mitigations?

maya: ugh. Do we have the exact timestamps and org_id? can you also share the rate-limit headers returned (X-RateLimit-*) if available? :thinking_face:

sam: timestamps: 2026-03-15T14:01:12Z -> 14:06:37Z spike. org_id: org_2468. Here are two sample headers from the response:

`X-RateLimit-Limit: 1200
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Burst-Credits: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 2026-03-15T14:21:37Z`

alex: FYI eng-oncall, this smells like burst-credit cooldown hitting the floor. Current smoothing window is 10m and refill_rate is 0.166 credits/sec (10 credits/min). If they consumed a lot in <5m, credits will take a while to come back. We can temporarily increase their reserved burst or raise refill_rate for that org.

eng-oncall-bot: [alert] quota_exhaustion org_2468 2026-03-15T14:07:02Z - 429 spike detected, 27 errors in 2m.

maya: For quick mitigation we can: 1) raise their burst bucket by +300 for 30m, or 2) apply a short grace policy to convert 429 -> 202 (soft-degraded) for service-critical routes. Which do we prefer?

tara: product note — long-term we should avoid manual fiddles. But for now option 1 is safer and less risky for callers. Also can we check if their client is retrying aggressively (hot loop)? that would chew credits.

sam: logs show dozens of concurrent requests after the promo email. They did 4 concurrent streams at ~10rps for ~3m. I'll ask Acme to add jitter/retries.

alex: I'll push a one-off patch to raise burst for org_2468 for 1 hour, and also enable temporary smoothing tweak (increase window to 15m) so refill is a bit faster. After that we should generate an incident doc with root-cause and a recommended config for customers with promo spikes.

maya: small ask for follow-up: can you capture the refill math in the incident? specifically: starting_credits, consumption, refill_rate, cooldown. customers ask for simple rules like "if you do X sustained rps for Y mins you'll need Z reserved".

sam: noted. I'll collect exact numbers and paste here in the incident doc. thanks all. :tada:
